note: R32a'' (2026-10-22, D-SINK-32, D-SINK-33). The ONE whitespace class that ends a free-text URL's RUN and its AUTHORITY in both redactors (Model.redactUrls / runHostParts through Model.isUrlSpaceAt, the helper's redact_urls / run_host_parts through _URL_SPACE and _URL_TAIL_RE, both built from URL_SPACE_CHARS), and the whitespace the two URL validators refuse. It is the union of JavaScript's \s (as node and Qt's V4 read it), Python's \s (str.isspace) and U+FEFF, enumerated code point by code point so that neither engine's own notion is ever consulted again: lane-bounds-s3's helper ended the run at Python \s plus quotes and the authority at Python \s plus U+FEFF, two classes, and a password holding U+FEFF printed the username. Both suites (tests/Model.test.js under 'R32a''', tests/test_helper.py under the same name) read this file and assert, for EVERY code point of the whole Unicode range, that the mirror's class holds exactly these; each also asserts its own engine's \s is a subset, so a change in either engine is seen rather than absorbed. `'`, `"`, `<` and `>` are NOT here on purpose: they ended the helper's run until R32a'' (D-SINK-33) and are trailing punctuation now (tests/fixtures/redaction-vectors.json).
